content.short: Idle Finance provides DeFi yield automation infrastructure to optimize digital asset allocation across leading DeFi protocols.
content.description: Idle Finance is a decentralized protocol and suite of products that provides a single gateway to yield opportunities across decentralized finance. It enables users to optimize their digital asset allocation across leading DeFi protocols through automated, algorithmic strategies, allowing them to pursue higher returns while actively monitoring risk and performance. Whether the aim is to maximize yield or to maintain a balanced risk/return profile, Idle Finance streamlines multi‑protocol asset management in a transparent, composable environment.
content.meta: Idle Finance is a decentralized protocol and suite of products for automated yield in DeFi. Discover Idle Finance and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Splitting Yield Into Senior and Junior
resources.tldr: The same pool, two risk positions. Senior holders get first claim on the assets; junior holders get paid more for absorbing losses first.

resources.title: The Adaptive Yield Split
resources.tldr: The APY split moves with how much liquidity sits on each side, rather than being fixed at launch. Why that matters to a depositor.

resources.title: Reward Tranches Against Yield Tranches
resources.tldr: Two products that look similar and pay for different things. Worth reading before choosing which side to deposit into.
